Every method of `Waitlist`, grouped by resource. Types are under the `Waitlist` namespace (`import type { Waitlist } from "@productcraft/waitlist"`). Every method takes per-request options last (`{ idempotencyKey, timeout, maxRetries, headers, signal, workspaceId }`).

## lists

### `waitlist.lists.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/waitlists` → `Waitlist.Waitlist`

Create a waitlist (workspace-scoped).

Pass `status: "active"` to accept public sign-ups straight away. Without it the waitlist starts as a draft, and the response says so in `accepting_signups: false` and `signups_note`.

- Params: `Waitlist.ListCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failure, including an `allowed_origins` entry that is not a plain origin. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `waitlist.create`, or workspace has not enabled the `waitlist` service. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Slug already taken in this workspace. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const list = await waitlist.lists.create({ display_name: "Early Access Program", slug: "early-access" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/waitlist/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-waitlists)

### `waitlist.lists.delete(id, options?)`

`DELETE /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/waitlists/{id}` → `void`

Delete a waitlist (cascades to entries).

Deletes the waitlist with all its entries and variants. Cannot be undone.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `waitlist.delete`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Waitlist not found. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await waitlist.lists.delete("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/waitlist/api-reference#delete-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-waitlists-id)

### `waitlist.lists.list(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/waitlists` → `PagePromise<Waitlist.Waitlist>`

List waitlists in this workspace.

Newest first, cursor-paginated. Filter by `status`.

- Params: `Waitlist.ListListParams`
- Paginated: `for await` iterates every item; `await` gives one page

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid cursor, `limit` outside 1-100, or an unknown `status`. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `waitlist.list`, or workspace has not enabled the `waitlist` service. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
for await (const list of waitlist.lists.list()) {
  console.log(list);
}
const page = await waitlist.lists.list({}, { timeout: 5_000 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/waitlist/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-waitlists)

### `waitlist.lists.update(id, params?, options?)`

`PATCH /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/waitlists/{id}` → `Waitlist.Waitlist`

Update waitlist metadata and settings.

Only the fields you send change. `settings` is merged shallowly into the saved settings; `allowed_origins` replaces the whole list. Use `PATCH …/status` to open, pause or close the waitlist.

- Params: `Waitlist.ListUpdateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failure, including an `allowed_origins` entry that is not a plain origin. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Waitlist not found. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const list = await waitlist.lists.update("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { allowed_origins: ["https://acme.com"] });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/waitlist/api-reference#patch-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-waitlists-id)

### `waitlist.lists.entries.bulk(waitlistId, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/waitlists/{waitlist_id}/entries/bulk` → `Waitlist.BulkEntryActionResult`

Approve, reject or invite up to 100 entries at once.

Applies one action to every id, serially. Per-row results are returned, so one bad id does not fail the batch.

| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `entry.update`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Waitlist not found. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |


### `waitlist.lists.entries.export(waitlistId, params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/waitlists/{waitlist_id}/entries/export.csv` → `Response`

### `waitlist.lists.entries.inviteToApp(waitlistId, entryId, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/waitlists/{waitlist_id}/entries/{entry_id}/invite-to-app` → `Waitlist.EntryInvite`

Invite an entry into a linked Auth app.

One-click handoff from Waitlist to Auth: creates an invite in the Auth consumer app (`app_slug`, else the workspace default) and, unless `send_email: false`, sends the approval email with the invite link. Stamps `invited_at` and `invited_to_app_slug` on the entry.

| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `entry.update`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Entry not found in this waitlist. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | No linked Auth app for this workspace |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

## lists.testEntries

### `waitlist.lists.testEntries.create(waitlistId, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/waitlists/{waitlist_id}/test-entries` → `Waitlist.Entry`

Add a test signup.

Creates an entry marked `is_test` with a generated Amazon SES mailbox-simulator address (`success+test-…@simulator.amazonses.com`). Works on draft and paused waitlists and ignores `max_entries`. The entry shows in the entries list, takes a negative position, and is left out of counts, analytics, exports and webhooks unless asked. No email is sent unless `send_welcome_email` is true. Delete it like any other entry.

- Params: `Waitlist.ListTestEntryCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failure. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `waitlist.update`, or workspace has not enabled the `waitlist` service. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Waitlist not found in this workspace. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency-Key reused with a different body. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | The waitlist is closed. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const entry = await waitlist.lists.testEntries.create("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { name: "Test signup" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/waitlist/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-waitlists-waitlist-id-test-entries)

### `waitlist.lists.variants.create(waitlistId, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/waitlists/{waitlist_id}/variants` → `Waitlist.Variant`

Create a variant.

A `locale` variant serves its copy to visitors whose `?lang=` or `Accept-Language` matches; `ab` variants of one locale are picked at random by `weight` on each public info read.

- Params: `Waitlist.ListVariantCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failure |

## settings

### `waitlist.settings.retrieve(options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/waitlist/settings` → `Waitlist.WaitlistSettings`

Read workspace-level Waitlist defaults.

The settings plus `email_setup` (whether Waitlist emails can go out and what is missing; the sender domain and template names are checked against Mail, cached for up to 60 seconds) and `skipped_sends` (emails not sent in the last 7 days because the setup was incomplete). Waitlist never falls back to a ProductCraft sender: an email that cannot go out is recorded, not sent.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | No valid session or API key. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `waitlist.settings.read` on the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace does not exist or is not Waitlist-enabled. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const waitlistSettings = await waitlist.settings.retrieve();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/waitlist/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-waitlist-settings)

### `waitlist.settings.update(params?, options?)`

`PUT /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/waitlist/settings` → `Waitlist.WaitlistSettings`

Update workspace-level Waitlist defaults.

Only the fields you send change. Returns the settings with the email setup state, like the read.

- Params: `Waitlist.SettingsUpdateParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failure on the patch body (per `UpdateSettingsDto`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | No valid session or API key. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `waitlist.settings.update` on the workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace does not exist or is not Waitlist-enabled. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const waitlistSettings = await waitlist.settings.update({ approved_template_name: "waitlist-approved" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/waitlist/api-reference#put-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-waitlist-settings)

## settings.notifications

### `waitlist.settings.notifications.test(slot, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/waitlist/settings/notifications/{slot}/test` → `Waitlist.NotificationTest`

Send me a test of one Waitlist email.

Sends the slot's real Mail template, with the workspace's real Waitlist sender (the workspace default or the custom address) and example values, to your own verified account address. It cannot be sent anywhere else. It uses your own Mail access, goes through the same send path as real emails, and shows up in Mail > Emails. At most 10 tests per person per hour. Not available to API keys (a key has no inbox).

- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Unknown `slot`, or `workspaceId` is not a UUID. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | No valid session or API key. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `waitlist.settings.update`, or Mail refused the send for your role (you need Mail send access in this workspace). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not Waitlist-enabled, or the slot's template no longer exists in Mail. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 412 | `APIError` | `PRECONDITION_FAILED` | `no_template`: the slot has no template. `no_sender_address`: custom sender mode with no address. |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `no_default_sender`, `from_domain_not_verified`, `domain_not_verified_by_provider` | `operator_email_unavailable`: the caller has no verified account email (API keys included). From Mail: `no_default_sender` (workspace mode and no default sender set in Mail), `from_domain_not_verified`, `domain_not_verified_by_provider`, a suppressed address, or a render failure. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 10 tests by you in the last hour (`RATE_LIMITED`), or over a Mail send limit. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |
| 503 | `InternalServerError` | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, `MAIL_UNREACHABLE` | `MAIL_UNREACHABLE`: Mail did not answer. |

```ts
const notificationTest = await waitlist.settings.notifications.test("welcome");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/waitlist/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-waitlist-settings-notifications-slot-test)

## stats

### `waitlist.stats.retrieve(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/stats` → `Waitlist.WaitlistWorkspaceStats`

Waitlist stats for a workspace.

Waitlist count, total entries, signups in the window, the most recent signup and a daily signup series, across every waitlist in the workspace.

**Active** means a signup: a new waitlist entry.

Days are UTC. Counts only: no entrant emails, names, referrers or IPs. Cached for up to 60 seconds (`generated_at`).

- Params: `Waitlist.StatsRetrieveParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `window` is not one of 1d, 7d, 30d. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `waitlist.read` on the workspace, or Waitlist is not enabled on it (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found: the id is unknown, is not a UUID, or is not visible to the caller. Same answer as the service's other workspace routes. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const waitlistWorkspaceStats = await waitlist.stats.retrieve();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/waitlist/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-stats)

## webhooks

### `waitlist.webhooks.unwrap({ payload, headers, secret? })`

Verifies the signature and returns `Waitlist.UnwrapWebhookEvent`. Events: `entry.approved`, `entry.created`, `entry.rejected`, plus `UnknownWebhookEvent` for types added later.

### `waitlist.webhooks.sign({ payload, secret?, id?, timestamp? })`

Signs a test event exactly as ProductCraft signs deliveries (Standard Webhooks) and returns `{ payload, headers }`, ready for `unwrap` or a request to your handler. For tests; real deliveries come signed.

## webhooks.endpoints

### `waitlist.webhooks.endpoints.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/endpoints` → `Waitlist.WebhookEndpointWithSecret`

Add a webhook endpoint. Returns its signing secret once.

Deliveries are signed with the Standard Webhooks headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp` and `webhook-signature` (`v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256 of "<id>.<timestamp>.<body>">`); the returned `whsec_…` secret works unchanged with any Standard Webhooks library. Failed deliveries are retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h and 24 h.

- Params: `Waitlist.WebhookEndpointCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN` | Validation failure: URL not https with a public host, or an unknown event type (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `waitlist.webhook.read` (reads) or `waitlist.webhook.manage` (changes, Send test, replay), or Waitlist is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Already 10 endpoints (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT`), or Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | The URL points at a private, loopback or internal address. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEndpoint = await waitlist.webhooks.endpoints.create({ url: "https://api.acme.com/webhooks" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/waitlist/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-endpoints)

```ts
const webhookEndpoint = await waitlist.webhooks.endpoints.update("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { description: "Production receiver" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/waitlist/api-reference#patch-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-endpoints-endpoint-id)

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/event-types` → `Waitlist.WebhookEventTypeList`

List the events an endpoint can subscribe to.

Each type with a plain description, its group and an example `data` object (what "Send test" delivers).

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|

| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEventTypeList = await waitlist.webhooks.eventTypes.list();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/waitlist/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-event-types)

## webhooks.events

### `waitlist.webhooks.events.list(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/events` → `PagePromise<Waitlist.WebhookEvent>`

List webhook events, newest first (kept for 30 days).

Every event logged while at least one endpoint existed, with the latest state per endpoint and when the next retry is due.

- Params: `Waitlist.WebhookEventListParams`
- Paginated: `for await` iterates every item; `await` gives one page

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid filter value or cursor. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `waitlist.webhook.read` (reads) or `waitlist.webhook.manage` (changes, Send test, replay), or Waitlist is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
for await (const event of waitlist.webhooks.events.list()) {
  console.log(event);
}
const page = await waitlist.webhooks.events.list({}, { timeout: 5_000 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/waitlist/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-events)

### `waitlist.webhooks.events.replay(eventId, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/events/{event_id}/replay` → `Waitlist.WebhookEventReplay`

Send a logged event again, to its endpoints or to one endpoint.

Same body and `webhook-id`, freshly signed, to every switched-on endpoint that receives this event type now, or only to `endpoint_id`. Waits for the receivers (up to 15 s each) and returns the attempts. A success cancels a retry still queued for that endpoint.

- Params: `Waitlist.WebhookEventReplayParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `event_id` is not `evt_<uuid>`, or `endpoint_id` is not a UUID. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `waitlist.webhook.read` (reads) or `waitlist.webhook.manage` (changes, Send test, replay), or Waitlist is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | No such event here (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND`); events are kept for 30 days. Or No such endpoint here (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_SUBSCRIBED`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `endpoint_id` is switched off or does not receive this event type (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_SUBSCRIBED`), or Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEventReplay = await waitlist.webhooks.events.replay("evt_3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/waitlist/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-events-event-id-replay)

### `waitlist.webhooks.events.retrieve(eventId, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/events/{event_id}` → `Waitlist.WebhookEventDetail`

Get one webhook event with every delivery attempt.

The event as it was sent (`type`, `data`) and every delivery attempt to every endpoint, with its trigger, HTTP status, error and the start of the response body. Use it to debug a receiver, then `replay` to send it again.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `event_id` is not `evt_<uuid>`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `waitlist.webhook.read` (reads) or `waitlist.webhook.manage` (changes, Send test, replay), or Waitlist is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND` | No such event here (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND`); events are kept for 30 days. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEventDetail = await waitlist.webhooks.events.retrieve("evt_3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/waitlist/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-events-event-id)

## public(…).entries

### `waitlist.public({ … }).entries.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/waitlists/{workspace_slug}/{waitlist_slug}/entries` → `Waitlist.PublicEntryCreated`

Submit a new entry to a public waitlist.

The sign-up your form posts. No API key, callable from a browser; a waitlist with `allowed_origins` only accepts browsers on those origins. When the waitlist has a reCAPTCHA site key, send a `recaptcha_token`. Values for custom fields go in `metadata`; `variant_id` from the info read attributes the sign-up to a variant, and `referral_code` credits the referrer.

- Params: `Waitlist.EntryCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Public: no API key, browser-safe

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation or spam check failed |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The request came from a web origin (`Origin` header) that is not on the waitlist's `allowed_origins` list. Requests without an `Origin` header (server-side calls) are not checked. A CORS preflight from such an origin gets the same 403. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WAITLIST_NOT_FOUND` | Code `WAITLIST_NOT_FOUND`: no such waitlist, or its workspace was deleted. The answer is the same in both cases. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Email already on this waitlist Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | Waitlist is not active or is full |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Too many requests from this IP Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const publicEntryCreated = await waitlist.public({ workspace: "acme", waitlist: "beta" }).entries.create({ email: "ada@example.com", name: "Ada Lovelace" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/waitlist/api-reference#post-v1-waitlists-workspace-slug-waitlist-slug-entries)

## public(…).info

### `waitlist.public({ … }).info.retrieve(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/waitlists/{workspace_slug}/{waitlist_slug}` → `Waitlist.PublicWaitlistInfo`

Public waitlist info (display name, description, custom-field schema, branding hints, active variant).

What your sign-up form renders: the copy (from the variant served for this request's language, if any), the custom fields, the reCAPTCHA site key, referral rewards and brand hints. Only an `active` waitlist answers; anything else is 404 `WAITLIST_NOT_FOUND`. No API key.

- Params: `Waitlist.InfoRetrieveParams`
- Public: no API key, browser-safe

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WAITLIST_NOT_FOUND` | Code `WAITLIST_NOT_FOUND`: no such waitlist, not active, or its workspace was deleted. The answer is the same in every case. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const publicWaitlistInfo = await waitlist.public({ workspace: "acme", waitlist: "beta" }).info.retrieve();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/waitlist/api-reference#get-v1-waitlists-workspace-slug-waitlist-slug)

## public(…).leaderboard

`GET /v1/waitlists/{workspace_slug}/{waitlist_slug}/leaderboard/top` → `Waitlist.PublicLeaderboard`

Public referral leaderboard: the top entries by honoured referrals, emails masked.

The same rows as the deprecated `GET …/leaderboard`, in a `{ data }` envelope. Not paginated: at most 50 rows. Anonymous read with the same access policy as the public waitlist info. No API key.

| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const publicLeaderboard = await waitlist.public({ workspace: "acme", waitlist: "beta" }).leaderboard.list();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/waitlist/api-reference#get-v1-waitlists-workspace-slug-waitlist-slug-leaderboard-top)

## Error codes

`err.code` on an `APIError` is one of these (an open set: new codes may appear).

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `BAD_REQUEST` | The request is malformed (not valid JSON, a bad header, an unusable parameter). |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | One or more request fields are invalid; `errors` lists each field (`param`, `message`, `code`). |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | No credentials, or the token or API key is invalid, expired or revoked. |
| `PAYMENT_REQUIRED` | The workspace has no credit or plan for this operation. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | The caller is authenticated but not allowed to do this. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | The resource does not exist, or belongs to another workspace or app. |
| `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` | The route does not accept this HTTP method. |
| `NOT_ACCEPTABLE` | The route cannot produce the requested content type. |
| `REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | The request took too long to arrive. |
| `CONFLICT` | The request conflicts with the current state of the resource. |
| `GONE` | The resource existed but has been removed for good. |
| `PRECONDITION_FAILED` | A precondition header did not match. |
| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | The request body is over the size limit. |
| `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body is not in a content type the route accepts. |
| `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | The request is well-formed but cannot be carried out. |
| `PRECONDITION_REQUIRED` | The route requires a precondition header. |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | Too many requests; retry after the `Retry-After` header. |
| `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` | An unexpected server error. Retrying is safe for idempotent requests; quote `request_id` to support. |
| `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` | The server does not support this operation. |
| `BAD_GATEWAY` | An upstream service returned an invalid response. |
| `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | The service or one of its dependencies is temporarily unavailable; retry. |
| `GATEWAY_TIMEOUT` | An upstream service did not answer in time; retry. |
| `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The workspace has not enabled this product. |
| `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` | The credentials were not accepted. |
| `SESSION_REVOKED` | The session behind this token was signed out or revoked. |
| `MCP_NOT_PERMITTED` | An MCP (agent) token cannot call this route. |
| `MCP_WORKSPACE_MISMATCH` | The MCP token was issued for a different workspace. |
| `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | A workspace API key cannot call this route. |
| `ACTIONS_NOT_GRANTABLE` | The policy grants actions the caller does not hold. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` | The `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED` | This operation requires an `Idempotency-Key` header. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | A request with the same `Idempotency-Key` is still running. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds with the same key to get its response. |
| `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT` | The workspace has the maximum number of webhook endpoints. |
| `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | No webhook endpoint with this id in this workspace. |
| `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_SUBSCRIBED` | The endpoint is not subscribed to this event type. |
| `WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND` | No webhook event with this id in this workspace. |
| `WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN` | The event type is not one this product sends. |
| `MAIL_UNREACHABLE` | The Mail service did not answer; try again in a minute. |
| `ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED` | Origin not allowed. |
| `WAITLIST_NOT_FOUND` | No waitlist with this id or slug in this workspace. |
| `domain_not_verified_by_provider` | The From domain's DNS records have been broken for over 72 h, so it no longer sends. |
| `from_domain_not_verified` | The From domain is not an active sending domain of this workspace (`details: { fqdn, reason }`). |
| `no_default_sender` | No `from` and the workspace has no default sender. |
